scope: Functional regression, not throughput or SKU qualification
result: The semantic warm response now retains hits=1 and restore_source=2, where the previous candidate returned zero. Both modes retain 1024 runner-reused tokens. All four output token sequences match the previous candidate.
counter_contract: Hit values retain the maximum observed step value, not an additive per-request total of batch deltas. Restore source is latest nonzero; gauges remain last-observation.
curation: Request token IDs are stored once in request.json. Output tokens, status, route and performance fields are retained verbatim. Runtime paths/host fields are excluded; full source responses remain in the internal engineering record.
